cands.name: Jose Alvarez
cands.bio: Kissimmee Democrat, 62, first-term House member since Nov. 2024. Former Mayor of Kissimmee (2016-20) and city commissioner; real estate and business consultant (News Collaborative guide).

record.text: Received the Florida League of Cities 2026 Legislative Appreciation Award for protecting local decision-making.
Supported restrictions on petition gathering that House Democratic leadership opposed, which reportedly led to a public argument with Leader Fentrice Driskell; she described the exchange differently.

endorsements.text: Republican Rep. Fabian Basabe endorsed his re-election.

cands.gaps: No donor reporting found. The Wikipedia entry has doubtful citations, so I used news sources only.
